responsibility: Implements construction, maintenance, and verification of SSA operand caches and immediate-use chains for GIMPLE statements. It scans statements to collect real uses/defs and virtual operands, finalizes and updates per-statement operand vectors, supports swapping and rewriting operand links while preserving immediate-use structure, verifies def-use lists, dumps operand/use information for debugging, and provides helpers such as unlink_stmt_vdef that other passes rely on when removing or rewriting memory-defining statements.
same_name_distinction: Contains the implementation for building, updating, verifying, and dumping SSA operand caches and immediate-use chains, including helpers like unlink_stmt_vdef. Unlike gcc/tree-ssa-operands.h, it is not the macro/type/interface layer for operand access but the code that scans statements and maintains those structures.
